title: Compensatory short–long RR pairing does not establish incremental AF-detection benefit in external-database testing
abstract: In AFDB-to-LTAFDB transfer, adding near-compensatory adjacent short-long RR pair frequency to nine flexible interval descriptors changed equal-record log loss by -0.0009247; source-refit/target-record bootstrap95% interval [-0.01650, 0.01940] does not establish incremental benefit. Existing-public-data analysis:2687 source windows/25 recordings,17623 external windows/83 recordings. Quality-filter sensitivity and prior target exposure limit confirmation. Pairing is not a validated ectopy measure. AI authorship and author self-checks disclosed.
